name: 项目综合看板
description: 一级看板：项目综合态势总览，进度为主轴 + 异常标红，核心维度：项目 + 科室。

sqlConfig.query: WITH progress AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS project_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS project_active, SUM(s.completed_total_cnt) AS completed_sum, SUM(s.due_cnt + s.outside_completed_cnt) AS due_sum FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]), quality AS (SELECT SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS open_quality_issues FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND q.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND q.dept = {{deptId}}]]), tech AS (SELECT SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS pending_reform_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND t.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND t.dept = {{deptId}}]]), risk AS (SELECT SUM(r.high_cnt) AS high_risk_cnt FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND r.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND r.dept = {{deptId}}]]) SELECT p.project_total AS "项目总数", p.project_active AS "进行中项目", CASE WHEN p.due_sum = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.completed_sum::numeric / p.due_sum::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "项目完成率", COALESCE(q.open_quality_issues, 0) AS "未闭环质量问题数", COALESCE(t.pending_reform_cnt, 0) AS "未整改落实技术更改单数", COALESCE(r.high_risk_cnt, 0) AS "高风险数量" FROM progress p, quality q, tech t, risk r

SELECT d.project_no AS "项目编号", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "已完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.completion_status = '正常待完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "正常待完成", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "完成率" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] GROUP BY d.project_no ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT d.dept AS "责任科室", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "已完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "完成率" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] AND d.dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.dept ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT q.project_no AS "label", SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS "value" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND q.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND q.dept = {{deptId}}]] GROUP BY q.project_no HAVING SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) DESC

SELECT q.dept AS "责任科室", SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS "现存问题", SUM(q.zero_completed_cnt) AS "已归零" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND q.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND q.dept = {{deptId}}]] AND q.dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.dept ORDER BY SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) DESC

SELECT t.project_no AS "项目编号", SUM(t.reform_done_i_ii) AS "已整改", SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS "未整改", SUM(t.order_unsigned_cat_i + t.order_unsigned_cat_ii + t.order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS "未签署" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND t.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND t.dept = {{deptId}}]] GROUP BY t.project_no ORDER BY SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) DESC

SELECT t.dept AS "label", SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS "value" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND t.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND t.dept = {{deptId}}]] AND t.dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.dept HAVING SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) DESC

SELECT r.project_no AS "项目编号", SUM(r.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(r.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(r.low_cnt) AS "低风险" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND r.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND r.dept = {{deptId}}]] GROUP BY r.project_no ORDER BY SUM(r.high_cnt) DESC

SELECT r.dept AS "责任科室", SUM(r.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(r.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(r.low_cnt) AS "低风险" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND r.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND r.dept = {{deptId}}]] AND r.dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.dept ORDER BY SUM(r.high_cnt) DESC

config.text: 项目进度甘特图（进行中项目）

sqlConfig.query: WITH active_projects AS (SELECT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] GROUP BY project_no HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) SELECT d.project_no AS "重大项目", COALESCE(d.subsystem, '(无子项目)') AS "子项目", d.node_task AS "任务", d.node_type AS "类型", to_char(d.plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "计划日期", to_char(d.actual_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "实际日期", d.is_completed AS "是否完成", d.is_overdue_completed AS "是否超期完成", d.is_incomplete AS "是否未完成", COALESCE(d.delay_days, 0) AS "延期天数", d.risk_level AS "风险等级", d.completion_status AS "完成情况", d.dept AS "责任科室", d.owner AS "责任人", d.project_manager AS "项目经理" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d INNER JOIN active_projects ap ON ap.project_no = d.project_no WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] ORDER BY d.project_no, d.subsystem NULLS LAST, d.plan_date
SELECT DISTINCT dept AS label, dept AS value FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE dept IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dept
